## What changes?

Describe the operator problem and the resulting behavior.

## People and learning

What can an operator learn, inspect, challenge, or decide because of this change? For workflow changes, describe operator review, evidence, authority, and failure handling. Identify the relevant roadmap gate and any missing operator validation. For documentation-only changes, state the learning outcome.

Does this change affect the charter, governance, employment commitments, or publication of operational data? If so, link the explicit proposal and review required by GOVERNANCE.md.

## Evidence and scope

Link official sources and state when they were checked. Explain any geographic, permit-type, or event limits. Identify observations that remain experimental.

## Verification

Describe the relevant validation, tests, and manual review. For a parser change, include a synthetic intended case and an easily confused case.

- [ ] Public examples are synthetic; no private inbox, CRM data, credentials, or live permit links are included.
- [ ] Claims are supported and their unknowns are explicit.
- [ ] Relevant validation and tests pass.
- [ ] Profile revisions are recorded and source-check dates were updated when applicable.
- [ ] Human impact and current-versus-future capabilities are explicit; no unfunded employment or unvalidated automation promises were introduced.
